title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1967-03-18

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard capture with a touch of hiss, showcasing a smoking Morning Dew, The Same Thing jam and an epic Death Don't.
ai_review.review: The recording is a solid sound‑board source – vocals and guitars are crisp despite a bit of hiss and no drop‑outs. Musically the show shines: early‑Dead energy, standout performances of Smokestack Lightning, Morning Dew, The Same Thing (with an inspired Jerry jam) and a remarkable Death Don't that many reviewers call one of the best versions.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviews are favorable, with an average of 4.7 stars; performance is praised as exceptional while recording quality is noted as good but not pristine.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear vocal and guitar presence, a bit of hiss described as "funky sound," no drop‑outs or tape‑speed issues; one reviewer notes it’s decent but another mentions a better alternative exists.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑Dead set with fast‑paced, tightly linked songs; a long jam in The Same Thing and an especially powerful Death Don't close the night.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Creative, bending guitar work during the long jam in The Same Thing; one reviewer notes he isn’t enamored with his Guild Starfire tone but still impressive.
band_member_comments.Phil: Brilliant bass playing highlighted as a major strength of this early show.
band_member_comments.Bob: Described as "droolingly breathless" – vocal performance noted positively.
